_comment: Seed fixture for the affected-files-htmx widget-type bead.
Created for ka-0000005289 (Phase 4 free-htmx port — seventh port
(widgets_phase4.go) rather than replacing it. Authoring path:
template_source under html/template and reject malformed inputs at
createBead/updateBead time, so a bad fixture surfaces immediately.
Schema validation runs against widget-instance writes per the same
pre-write hook; the schema below is the wire contract.
The wire contract mirrors the Go-coded `affected-files` renderer at
path / line / reason. The htmx template intentionally does NOT
construct the per-row Open-in-IDE action button (it needs the
Go-side OpenIDEAction helper); button rendering is a parity gap
documented in the port doc and in TestAffectedFilesParity.

fields.template_source:
{{- $files := index .Payload "files" -}} {{if $files}}
    {{range $files}}
  • {{.path}}{{if .line}}:{{.line}}{{end}} {{if .reason}}{{.reason}}{{end}}
    • {{end}}
{{else}}

No affected files.

{{end}}
